lang: STATIC mode - cache updates every interval (interval shortened to 5 seconds)

comment: Clear down and switch setter to static mode
Set setter's interval to 5 seconds
Start the cache timer
Check the timer runs on the configured interval
Wait for the timer's first run - a timer added to a running proc first runs when the proc's next timer is due
Check the timer built a cache
Check the cache is marked complete
Save the first cache
Save when the first cache was started
Wait - less than one interval since the first cache
Check no new cache is built before the interval is up
Wait for the timer's next run
Check a new cache was built once the interval was up
Check the new cache was started one interval after the first
Check the previous cache was deleted
Check readers get the new cache
Stop the cache timer
Put setter's interval back
Clear down caches
Mock a cache built 1 second ago
Run a cache build
Check setter checked the existing cache
Check nothing needs building when the cache is younger than the interval
Check no new cache is built when the cache is younger than the interval
